ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and specular highlights in the central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation field covering >90% of the surface area; high-contrast irregular white/grey clusters localized at the left and right terminal tips; subtle mid-tone mottling and vertical high-intensity glare streaks near the central longitudinal axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 115 degrees; depth of notch occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke profile from the baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks increases significantly on the distal half of the right lobe compared to the more uniform medial serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve medially, transitioning to a sharp upward convex sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal linear disruptions of low-contrast intensity visible across the dark pigmented regions of both lobes, suggesting surface scratches or rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the superior and inferior surfaces of the distal tips; highly irregular, non-symmetrical trailing edge morphology indicative of significant wear or prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged 'sawtooth' profile of the trailing edge, particularly a deep, irregular indentation on the outer third of the right lobe.
